description:
The public JSONPlaceholder service accepts everything (see features/jsonplaceholder). This feature runs the same
  boundary and invalid-data payloads against a local posts API that validates, to demonstrate the expected outcome:
  appropriate 4xx codes and error messages for invalid input, and no 5xx for any input.

elements.name: Control - a valid post is created

steps.name: I create a post using the "valid" payload
the response status is 201
the response body echoes the "valid" payload and adds an id

elements.name: Excessively long title (title-1k) is rejected with 422

steps.name: I create a post using the "title-1k" payload
the response status is 422
the error code is "VALIDATION_FAILED"
the API does not fail with a server error

elements.name: Unsupported special characters (control-chars) are rejected

steps.name: I create a post using the "control-chars" payload
the response status is 422
the error code is "VALIDATION_FAILED"
the error for field "title" says "title contains unsupported control or bidirectional characters"

steps.name: I create a post using the "missing-body" payload

elements.name: Unknown fields are ignored and never stored

steps.name: I create a post using the "extra-fields" payload
the response status is 201
the response omits the field "isAdmin"

elements.name: Malformed JSON is a client error, not a server failure

steps.name: I send a malformed JSON body to create a post
the response status is 400
the error code is "MALFORMED_JSON"

elements.name: The wrong content type is rejected

steps.name: I create a post with the content type "text/plain"
the response status is 415
the error code is "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE"

name: A3 strict - a validating posts API rejects invalid input with proper error codes and never fails server-side
